Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: website template gallery thumbnail, direction A — interface preview.
Create one beautifully art-directed desktop homepage for a everyday nutrition coaching, warm home cooking and balanced meal flat lays. Category: Nutritionists. Concept: Everyday Nutrition.

Premium contemporary typography, disciplined spacing, sector-appropriate palette, original relevant imagery, clear contrast and appealing editorial composition.

Use case: ads-marketing

Landscape 4:3, edge-to-edge polished conceptual illustration, sophisticated tactile 3D and editorial mixed-media treatment, one strong central sector-specific motif with at most 3 supporting elements, rich materials, coherent sector-appropriate palette, sculpted soft light, carefully controlled negative space, strong silhouette readable at thumbnail size. No website UI, no screens, no devices, no browser frames, no text or letters, no watermark, no third-party logos, no fake awards, no before/after medical promises. One coherent illustration only; not a contact sheet. Distinctive and professional, not generic clip art.

Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: contextual website mockup for a template gallery thumbnail, direction C — contextual mockup.

One device and one scene only. No floating page collage, no contact sheet, no external logos, no watermark, no fake awards, no numeric popularity or medical outcome claims. Make the context genuinely specific to this business, not a generic desk reused for every concept.
